images.title: Four pictures side by side
images.purpose: Show the four pictures the video asks about, so the student can guess which ones repeat a pattern.
images.composition: One horizontal row of 4 flat drawings with wide gaps and a title above.
images.exact_structure: Title Symmetry centred at the top. One row of exactly 4 simple flat drawings, equal in size, evenly spaced: a round rangoli with 4 petals, a butterfly with open wings, a paper windmill with 4 blades, and a cloud with an uneven outline. Rangoli and windmill teal #0072B2, butterfly amber #E69F00, cloud plain grey outline. No marks or lines on any drawing. Exactly 4 drawings.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a doorway, photo, scene background, or any line drawn on a picture
images.takeaway: Some pictures repeat a pattern and some do not.
images.description: Four flat drawings in a row, a rangoli, a butterfly, a paper windmill and a cloud, under the word Symmetry, with no marks on them.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the pictures they think repeat a pattern, without saying yet who is right.

image_decisions.why: The hook picture is a simple flat row of four pictures that sets up the question for the next topic.
